info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get It Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The IT Management Query API provides access to system development details based on specific parameters. By utilizing the provided param1, consumers can efficiently retrieve crucial information regarding IT management processes and performance. This API is particularly useful for developers, analysts, and project managers seeking insights into system development alignment with business objectives. The endpoint serves as a foundational tool for reporting and decision-making in IT governance and project management.

get.summary: Retrieve system development details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about a specific system development resource identified by its unique ID. It is essential for understanding the configuration and status of a particular system development in the IT management context.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to retrieve information about the specific system development resource identified by RES-100045. The expected format is JSON, and the schema defines the structure of the required data.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the relevant data is returned.

GetItManagementByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the IT Management System Development API. It is expected to be a string that may carry relevant information or data payload.

environment.description: The environment in which the system operates (e.g., Production, Staging).

changeId.description: Identifier for the change associated with the system.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the system.

plannedAt.description: Date and time when changes are planned to be applied.

serviceTier.description: Service tier of the system (e.g., Basic, Premium).

availabilityTargetPercent.description: The target percentage for system availability.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the system record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the system record.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the system.

GetItManagementByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for retrieving system development operations data.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate multiple requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Geographical region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata containing information about the response context.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that was invoked, allowing for traceability and monitoring of API usage.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that processed the request. This helps in identifying which service handled the API call.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Authentication method, where the client must include a JWT (JSON Web Token) in the Authorization header to authenticate requests. It allows secure access to protected resources.
